product_launches.description: Openrouter launched a platform that consolidates access to over 300 large language models (LLMs) from top providers, offering features like model comparison, customization, pay-as-you-go pricing, and advanced developer tools for API integration and workflow automation.

overview_description.description: OpenRouter is a platform that connects AI applications with large language models and cloud hosting providers, allowing users to optimize for costs, speed, and performance.  The platform supports over 180 AI models, offers a unified API, and includes functionalities like private chat and exploratory data capabilities. OpenRouter sets the new benchmark for large-scale AI inference with its global edge infrastructure, privacy-focused design, real-time accounting, and integrated billing.

about_short_description.short_description: OpenRouter is a platform that connects AI applications with large language models and cloud hosting providers.

product.name: OpenRouter API
product.description: An OpenAI-compatible API for accessing hundreds of language, image, embedding, and transcription models from multiple providers through one interface.

product.name: OpenRouter Model Routing
product.description: A model-inference routing service that distributes requests across providers and can fail over when a provider is unavailable, while supporting provider selection and data-policy controls.

product.name: OpenRouter Chat
product.description: A web-based chat interface for interacting with AI models available through OpenRouter.

product.name: OpenRouter Models Directory
product.description: A catalog for browsing and comparing more than 400 models from over 70 providers, including model capabilities, pricing, and usage information.

product.name: OpenRouter Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise offering for organizations using OpenRouter to manage team-based access to hosted AI models and model-provider integrations.
